title: Care Management Bulletin: Gathering Days for Prior Plan Papers on Prior Authorization Deadline Extensions
content:
**Rule.** The gathering days of a member-requested deadline extension follow the member's active care management episode and the care contacts its care team recorded in the month before the day of the request (a date counts when less than one whole month separates it from that day): where the active episode is Complex Case Management or Health Home Services and at least one such contact is recorded, the gathering days are five; where the active episode is of any other tier and at least one such contact is recorded, they are seven; otherwise they are ten.

The gathering days are the days a member-requested deadline extension on a Prior Authorization request allows for the member to obtain the prior plan's papers. Both parts of the condition come from the member's Care Management records: the tier of the episode whose status is active, and the care contacts its care team recorded.

## Truth table

| Active Care Management episode | Care contact in the month before the request | Gathering days |
|---|---|---|
| Complex Case Management or Health Home Services | at least 1 | 5 |
| any other tier | at least 1 | 7 |
| any tier | none | 10 |
| no active episode | any | 10 |

## Window edge (hypothetical dates)

For a request made on a hypothetical 20 May, a care contact dated 21 April counts, because less than one whole month separates it from 20 May; a contact dated 20 April does not, because one whole month separates them.

*Hypothetical:* a member in an active Health Home Services episode whose care team recorded a contact ten days before the request has 5 gathering days; the same member with the last contact seven weeks earlier has 10.
